Booth's trick: half the partial products, signs for free

Set two signed numbers and watch the multiplier recoded into digits -2..+2, read three bits at a time. Four partial products instead of eight, and two's complement just works.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • gHashTag/t27 specs/fpga/dsp/multipliers.t27 (t27#8985): every value on the page is its fn bodies, compiled to wasm (logic.js)
  • A. D. Booth, A signed binary multiplication technique, Q. J. Mech. Appl. Math. 4(2), 1951; O. L. MacSorley, High-speed arithmetic in binary computers, Proc. IRE 49, 1961: the radix-4 form
